title: Fermionic cosmic strings in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity
summary: We investigate topological defects produced by a chiral phase transition in a fermionic ultraviolet completion of dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity. The model contains a complex scalar field with a chiral Yukawa coupling to fermions. Below the chiral symmetry breaking scale, integrating out the gapped bulk modes produces a gravitational Chern-Simons coupling which, we argue, modifies cosmic string solutions from the phase transition.
